business_overview.one_sentence: IGG is a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed developer and publisher of mobile games and applications, headquartered in Singapore with global users and R&D/operations in multiple regions.

segments.name: mobile games
facts: Lords Mobile revenue over HK$3.1 billion in 2023
Doomsday: Last Survivors nearly HK$700 million

segments.name: APP Business
facts: APP Business contributed HK$580 million, 11% of 2023 revenue

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from global mobile games and applications through platforms, advertising channels and payment service providers.
business_notes: The group had over 1.7 billion users and over 25 million MAU disclosed in Management Discussion and Analysis.
Fuzhou Tianmeng structured contracts/VIE contributed 2.53% of 2023 group revenue and 7.64% of group assets.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023 operating cash flow turned positive but was modest; 2022 was negative. 2023 reported profit included investment fair value gains, investment dividends and bank interest. Fuzhou office construction capex is mainly growth/real estate-like office build, while maintenance technology capex is closer to servers, computers and software. Cash profit is therefore heavily discounted.

evidence.source: Consolidated statement of profit or loss, p.122
Consolidated statement of financial position p.124 and note 21(a), p.179
MDA liquidity paragraph p.12 and note 29(b), p.201

gaps: 2023 annual report does not split cash by listed-company parent, offshore operating subsidiaries and each PRC subsidiary other than Mainland China aggregate cash.
Only 2022-2023 operating cash flow/capital expenditure are directly available from the 2023 annual report; 2021 cash flow would require prior-year annual report for full three-year cash conversion.
No detailed maturity/exit path for unquoted FVTPL private equity funds; detachable value uses conservative haircut.
Maintenance versus growth capex is estimated because Fuzhou office construction and office renovations are combined in the disclosed capex table.
